clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, young Frostmane trolls gather in caves along the southern ridge. Grelin Whitebeard sends willing recruits to thin their numbers while Ironforge faces a trogg invasion.

Grelin Whitebeard watches the frozen valley from a bluff as Ironforge's soldiers fight troggs across the snowfields. The southern approaches still need watching. Grelin and his brother Senir came at the mountain authorities' command to learn whether the native ice trolls threatened the heartland. Grelin keeps watch alone and tracks their movements.

Grelin found that the local Frostmane clan had begun settling in a deep cave along Coldridge Valley's southern ridge. He believes a full military mobilization would waste dwarven manpower, so he hires capable local volunteers to cull the aggressive whelps. Thinning their young fighters could disrupt the camp before the Frostmane launch coordinated raids against nearby dwarven homesteads.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.
From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.
Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, friend.
